Turns out, the model isn’t actually from the unity store (not the one that’s in tarkov, anyways.) The knife in game is a real kukri knife, and so are these store models, the one in game is scanned with a machine that BSG owns for scanning 3d models and putting them in game (According to FortyOne, the voice actor for Usec 3 - Josh). I took the game’s model and the unity store model and compared them, there are visual differences on the handle, and the topology (in layman’s terms, the way it was modeled) is also very different.
Still doesn’t excuse what they did, but credit where credit is due.

comments.author: BookAboutBirds
comments.body_html:
Made an account just to say, if you are unable to see the Unheard Kukri ingame. You need to change a line of code in the mod’s file. (It seems the mod author forgot to enable the item in the trader’s inventory)

Goto: “ user\mods\Unheard Kukri - Unity Store Edition\db\Items “.

You should see a json file called “ unheard_kukri.json “. Open this file up with notepad or notepad ++, then press Ctrl + f to search for the line “ addtoTraders “ and you should find it between these two lines:

“ModdableItemBlacklist”: null,

“addtoTraders”: false, < This one.

“traderId”: “PEACEKEEPER”,

Change ‘false’ to ‘true’ on “addtoTraders” so that it becomes “addtoTraders”: true,. Then make sure to save the changes. Once I enabled this in the “ unheard_kukri.json “ file and got back ingame I saw the kukri in Peacekeepers’ inventory at lvl 1 before doing any quests. Hope this helps anyone confused!

Also, the mod works on version 3.8.1 of SPT as far as I am aware.

edit: BTW love the sarcasm of this mod, and the fact that I can use such an exclusive item.
